analysis.title: Equity Index Vol Update 11Nov26
key_insights: SPX closed at 7,619.38 (+1.31%), NDX 28,374.25 (+2.28%), RUT 2,846.262 (+0.88%), VIX 17.49 (-1.97pts). The rally was driven by AI optimism in the neocloud space, and spot continues to recover from last week's selloff.

Vol fell with spot: fixed strike vols compressed in the morning, then went bid alongside spot as the rally accelerated. Skew compressed, and the VIX futures curve shifted down, with ux1 and ux2 uninverting.
The desk thinks 1 month call spreads in SPX look attractive to play for a continued breakout in spot over the next few weeks.
After the close, futures fell on reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to meet as soon as today to discuss removing CEO Jensen Huang. NVDA sank 9% and NDX sold off 80bps.

Flow tilted strongly to risk-on expressions, mainly short dated SPX call spreads. The largest trade was a 27 Nov SPY 775/800 call spread, where the paper bought 55,626x at 2.68 live (bought the 20d calls, sold the 2d calls).

Traders are watching updates on a potential Nvidia CEO replacement and key inflation data on Friday morning. After realizing today's straddle 2x to the topside, tomorrow's SPX straddle is priced at 66bps (~$50) and Friday's at 88bps (~$67).
